title: +*DIFFERENTIAL CALCULUS
description: Explores limits, continuity, derivatives, and their applications for real-valued functions of a single variable. Explores topics graphically, numerically, and symbolically in real-life applications. Emphasizes abstraction, problem-solving, modeling, reasoning, communication, connections with other disciplines, and the appropriate use of technology.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: MTH 112, 112Z or minimum score of 075 in 'Math Placement - ALEKS'.
A minimum grade of C- is required in MTH 112 and MTH 112Z.
